review_samples.summary: A visitor reported excessive volume in Sala 1 and inadequate cooling.
A visitor praised the film selection but criticised lights during credits and toilet access/maintenance.
A visitor liked the smaller cinema and neighbourhood.
A visitor praised original-version programming but reported failed air conditioning during a long screening.
A visitor criticised a room reassignment and the replacement room’s screen and sound.
A visitor valued less-commercial films and the ability to watch multiple films on a day ticket.

conflicts.detail: Rooms 4–11 grouped as 172 in VenuesPlace versus 170 in Venuu; neither accepted as individual current-room capacities.
Practical-page general text mentions €1 for printed/online tickets; cinema FAQ wording applies it online. Theatre terms differ. Verify cinema checkout/box office.
Official sources contain both 360 and 364; keep both, do not choose a certified current total.
Detail page showed 11 reviews; directory showed 12. Snapshots retained as inconsistent, no fabricated reconciliation.
History overview labels Palau Savassona period from 1906; detailed institutional history states purchase/move on 20 May 1904. Preserve the distinction rather than asserting a cinema opening.
